reason: The cited evidence (E1) demonstrates L10 ordering and high magnetocrystalline anisotropy in a Pt-containing high-entropy film, but it uses a different base alloy (FeCoNiMnCu, not FeCoNi) and does not report coercivity for the L10 phase, so the direct link between Pt-induced L10 ordering and coercivity increase in FeCoNi-based HEAs is not fully supported.
premises: Pt addition to FeCoNi-based HEA can trigger L10 ordering
L10 ordering reduces symmetry and increases magnetocrystalline anisotropy
Increased magnetocrystalline anisotropy leads to higher coercivity
The L10 phase can be stabilized while maintaining high configurational entropy
The effect is achievable with controlled Pt addition and annealing
